Decision 83 (user decision 2026-10-17, option B): data correction of the frozen electric base, deviating from the PyPSA-Earth runoff allocation (build_renewable_profiles.py rescale_hydro: per-unit inflow proportional to upstream runoff). Reason: the author stock is incomplete and the runoff allocation produces physically impossible unit capacity factors (2.3-4.6), so its spatial shares are not credible; B sets the national hydro total of the stock (author + S4A/S4B additions, reservoir + run-of-river) to the observed generation x 1.1 and allocates it by capacity share, each unit keeping its own seasonal shape, which also removes the double counting of the added units; new-build reservoir / run-of-river candidates take the capacity-weighted per-MW inflow of the corrected same-country stock; PHS unaffected | [V5 X20, X20_SPEC 1.5] v5 main: the denominator is the capacity operating in 2025; construction units get the same per-MW inflow (v5_hydro_inflow_denominator_rule)
source: S4C instruction S4C-2 items 2-4; stop report S4C_STOP_02_HYDRO_DIAGNOSIS.md; user decision 2026-10-17
